label: Context
short: Giving the model what it needs before you ask.
strong: You brief the model like a colleague: the document, the thread, your notes. That is why its answers fit.
edge: Before the next question, paste in the brief, the thread and what good looks like. Then ask.
unmet: Context is everything the model can see when it answers: your files, your notes, the history. Without it, it guesses.
